_readme: Source for the seven service pages (/software.html, /apps.html, /websites.html, /ai-employees.html, /automations.html, /marketing.html, /content.html), the Build/Automate/Grow cards on /services.html and the investment cards on /pricing.html. `flow` feeds the animated How-it-works section on index.html and services.html. Run `npm run build:services` after editing. `investment` is 1-4 dollar signs. `pricingOffers` are offer ids from data/pricing.json and show their published price. Keep the mega-menu in js/swft-nav.js (SERVICES) in sync with name/menuLine/slug.

services.name: Custom Software & CRMs
services.title: Custom Software & CRMs for Small Businesses | SWFT Studios
services.description: SWFT Studios builds custom CRMs, dashboards and internal tools that replace the stack of subscriptions your team works around. NYC and North Jersey.
services.h1: One system that fits how you work.
services.lead: Stop paying for five apps that don't talk to each other. We build the CRM, job board or dashboard your team actually needs, and you own it.

outcomes.title: Fewer subscriptions
outcomes.text: Fold the tools you rent month after month into one system built around your process.

outcomes.title: One source of truth
outcomes.text: Customers, jobs, invoices and notes live in one place, so nobody re-types anything.

outcomes.title: Room to grow
outcomes.text: Add a feature when the business needs it, not when a vendor puts it on their roadmap.

includes: Discovery workshop to map how your team works today
Custom CRM, pipeline or job tracker built around that process
Role-based logins for owners, staff and contractors
Data import from spreadsheets and the tools you are leaving
Integrations with email, calendar, payments and accounting
Dashboards that show the numbers you check every week
Training session and written guide for your team
Hosting, backups and security updates after launch

steps.title: Map
steps.text: We sit with the people doing the work and map every step, tool and spreadsheet.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: You click through a working prototype before a line of production code is written.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: We ship in weekly releases you can test, so there are no surprises at the end.

steps.title: Launch & support
steps.text: We move your data over, train the team and stay on to keep it running.

services.priceNote: Scoped after a free strategy call

faq.q: Why build instead of buying another app?
faq.a: Off-the-shelf tools make you change how you work to fit them. When your team is paying for several tools and still keeping spreadsheets on the side, a custom system usually costs less over two to three years and removes the double entry.

faq.q: Do we own the software?
faq.a: Yes. You own the code and the data. We host and maintain it if you want us to, and hand it over if you don't.

faq.q: Can you connect it to the tools we keep?
faq.a: Usually. Most accounting, payment, email and calendar tools have an API we can connect to. We confirm every integration during discovery, before you commit to a build.

faq.q: How long does a build take?
faq.a: Most first versions take 6 to 12 weeks depending on scope. You see working software every week along the way.

services.name: Mobile & Web Apps
services.title: Mobile & Web App Development | SWFT Studios
services.description: SWFT Studios designs and builds iPhone, Android and web apps, customer portals and booking apps, from clickable prototype to app store launch.
services.lead: iPhone, Android and web apps, customer portals and booking apps designed around how people actually use them, from first prototype to launch day.

outcomes.title: Repeat customers
outcomes.text: An app on the home screen keeps you one tap away for reorders, bookings and loyalty.

outcomes.title: Self-serve customers
outcomes.text: Portals let clients check status, pay and upload files without calling your office.

outcomes.title: A product you can sell
outcomes.text: Turn what you know into an app your customers or your industry will pay for.

includes: Product strategy and feature list for version one
Clickable prototype you can test with real users
UI design for iPhone, Android and the web
Development with accounts, payments and notifications
Admin panel to manage users and content
App Store and Google Play submission
Analytics to see how people use the app
Monitoring, bug fixes and updates after launch

steps.title: Sprint
steps.text: A short design sprint turns the idea into a prototype you can put in front of customers.

steps.title: Build the MVP
steps.text: We build the smallest version that does the job well and launch it fast.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: We handle store submission, review and the launch-day checklist.

steps.title: Improve
steps.text: Usage data tells us what to build next, release by release.

faq.q: Do I need an iPhone app, an Android app or a web app?
faq.a: It depends on who uses it and how often. Many businesses start with a web app that works on every phone, then add store apps once usage proves the need. We recommend a path during the design sprint.

faq.q: What does the design sprint give me?
faq.a: A clickable prototype, a feature list for version one and a build estimate. It is yours to keep, whether or not we build it.

faq.q: Who handles the App Store submission?
faq.a: We do: listings, screenshots, privacy details and review responses. The developer accounts are in your name.

faq.q: What happens after launch?
faq.a: Apps need upkeep as phones and stores change. App Care covers monitoring, security updates, bug fixes and small improvements every month.

services.name: Websites
services.title: Website Design & Development | SWFT Studios
services.description: Fast, mobile-first websites on Webflow or Shopify that turn visitors into calls, bookings and sales. Published prices from SWFT Studios, NYC and North Jersey.
services.h1: A website that books the job.
services.lead: Fast, mobile-first sites that say what you do in seconds and make calling, booking or buying the obvious next step.

outcomes.title: More inquiries
outcomes.text: A clear offer on the first screen and a booking path on every page.

outcomes.title: Found on Google
outcomes.text: Clean structure, fast pages and the basics search engines and AI assistants read.

outcomes.title: Easy to keep fresh
outcomes.text: Edit text and photos yourself, or let us handle it every month.

includes: Custom design that matches your brand
Mobile-first build on Webflow or Shopify
Booking, quote or contact forms that reach your inbox
On-page SEO: titles, descriptions and clean URLs
Analytics to see where visitors come from
Optional on-site photo and video shoot
Domain connection and launch support
Hosting, updates and care plans after launch

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: We agree on the pages, the offer and the one action every visitor should take.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: You review the design on your phone and desktop before we build.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: We build, connect your forms and booking, and test on real devices.

steps.title: Launch & care
steps.text: We go live, watch the numbers and keep the site fast and current.

faq.q: Webflow or Shopify?
faq.a: Shopify if you sell products online, Webflow for almost everything else. We recommend one on the first call.

faq.q: How long does a website take?
faq.a: Most sites launch in 2 to 4 weeks once we have your content. Packages with a shoot add the shoot day to the schedule.

faq.q: Can I edit the site myself?
faq.a: Yes. Both platforms have simple editors and we show you how to use them. Website Care covers edits if you would rather not.

faq.q: What is not included?
faq.a: Platform and domain fees are paid directly to the platform. Every package lists exactly what is and is not included on the pricing page.

services.name: AI Employees
services.title: AI Employees: Answer and Book Leads 24/7 | SWFT Studios
services.description: SWFT Studios sets up AI assistants that answer calls, texts, chats and DMs, qualify leads and book appointments on your calendar around the clock.
services.lead: An AI assistant that answers your calls, texts, chats and DMs, qualifies the lead and books it on your calendar, day or night.

outcomes.title: Instant replies
outcomes.text: Every inquiry gets an answer in seconds, including nights, weekends and busy days on the job.

outcomes.title: Booked, not just answered
outcomes.text: It asks your qualifying questions and puts the appointment on your real calendar.

outcomes.title: Handed off when it matters
outcomes.text: Anything it should not handle goes straight to you with the full conversation attached.

includes: Assistant trained on your services, prices, area and policies
Website chat, SMS and social DM coverage
Phone answering and call-back on request
Lead qualification with the questions you ask today
Booking straight into your calendar
Instant hand-off to a person, with the transcript
Conversation log and lead summary in your CRM or inbox
Monthly review and tuning from real conversations

steps.title: Learn
steps.text: We collect your FAQs, prices, service area and the questions you ask every lead.

steps.title: Train & test
steps.text: We build the assistant and test it against real past inquiries before it goes live.

steps.title: Go live
steps.text: We connect it to your site, phone, inbox and calendar.

steps.title: Tune
steps.text: Every month we review conversations and tighten answers and hand-offs.

services.priceNote: Setup plus a monthly plan, quoted on a call

faq.q: Will customers know it is an AI?
faq.a: Yes. We set it up to say so. People mostly care that they got a fast, correct answer and a booked time.

faq.q: What if it does not know the answer?
faq.a: It says so and hands the conversation to you or your team with the full transcript, instead of guessing.

faq.q: Does it work with my calendar and phone number?
faq.a: It works with the common calendars and booking tools and can use your existing number or a new one. We confirm your setup on the strategy call.

faq.q: Is my customer data safe?
faq.a: Conversations are stored in your systems, access is limited to your team, and we never use your data to train public models.

services.name: Automations
services.title: Business Automations & Integrations | SWFT Studios
services.description: SWFT Studios connects your forms, CRM, calendar, invoices and inbox so follow-ups, reminders, review requests and reports run on their own.
services.lead: We connect the tools you already use so follow-ups, reminders, invoices and reports run themselves, and your team gets hours back every week.

outcomes.title: Faster follow-up
outcomes.text: New leads get a text and an email within a minute, and reminders until they book.

outcomes.title: Fewer no-shows
outcomes.text: Confirmations, reminders and text-to-pay go out on time, every time.

outcomes.title: More reviews
outcomes.text: Every finished job triggers a review request while the customer is still happy.

includes: Audit of the manual steps your team repeats each week
Lead capture from forms, calls and ads into one place
Instant text and email follow-up sequences
Appointment confirmations and reminders
Invoice, payment and text-to-pay workflows
Review requests after every job
Weekly report sent to your inbox
Monitoring and alerts if anything breaks

steps.title: Audit
steps.text: We list every manual step and rank them by hours saved.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: We wire up your forms, CRM, calendar, payments and inbox.

steps.title: Test
steps.text: Every flow is tested end to end with real data before it is switched on.

steps.title: Monitor
steps.text: We watch the flows, fix what breaks and add the next automation.

faq.q: Which tools can you connect?
faq.a: Most popular CRMs, calendars, form builders, payment, accounting and email tools. If a tool has an API or a Zapier/Make integration, we can usually connect it.

faq.q: Do I need new software?
faq.a: Usually not. We start with what you already pay for and only suggest a new tool when it clearly saves money or time.

faq.q: What happens if an automation fails?
faq.a: Every flow has alerts. If something breaks, we hear about it and fix it, and important messages fall back to a person.

faq.q: How fast will I see results?
faq.a: Lead follow-up and reminders usually go live in the first one to two weeks.

services.name: Paid Ads & Marketing
services.title: Paid Ads, SEO & Local Marketing | SWFT Studios
services.description: Meta and Google ads, local SEO, Google Business Profile and AI search visibility for local businesses in NYC and North Jersey, tracked from click to booked job.
services.lead: Meta and Google ads, local SEO and your Google Business Profile, tracked from the first click to the booked job so you know what every lead cost.

outcomes.title: Show up locally
outcomes.text: Rank in the map pack and in AI answers when people nearby search for what you do.

outcomes.title: Ads that reach buyers
outcomes.text: Campaigns aimed at the neighborhoods and customers you actually serve.

outcomes.title: Know your numbers
outcomes.text: Every call, form and sale has a source and a cost, in one monthly report.

includes: Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ad campaigns
Google Search and Local Services ads
Google Business Profile setup, posts and photos
Local SEO and location pages
Visibility in AI search answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity)
Call, form and booking tracking
Landing pages built for each campaign
Monthly report with the next three moves

steps.title: Audit
steps.text: We review your profile, site, past ads and competitors and find the biggest leak.

steps.title: Set up tracking
steps.text: We make sure every lead is counted and has a source before spending a dollar.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Campaigns and profile updates go live with creative made for each platform.

steps.title: Optimize
steps.text: We cut what does not work, scale what does and report monthly.

faq.q: Is ad spend included?
faq.a: No. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta or Google from your account. Our fee covers strategy, creative, setup and management.

faq.q: How much should I spend on ads?
faq.a: Enough to get meaningful data in your area, which for most local businesses starts at a few hundred dollars a month. We recommend a starting budget on the strategy call.

faq.q: What is AI search visibility?
faq.a: More people ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity for recommendations. We structure your site, profile and listings so those assistants can find and recommend you.

faq.q: Do I have to sign a long contract?
faq.a: No. Monthly plans are month to month.

services.lead: On-site photo, short-form video, brand films, social media and live streaming, planned around what your audience already responds to.

outcomes.title: Real, not stock
outcomes.text: Your space, your team and your work, shot on site and edited for every platform.

outcomes.title: Weeks of posts from one shoot
outcomes.text: Every shoot is planned to fill your site, profile, ads and feed.

outcomes.title: Always active

Short-form vertical video for Reels, TikTok and Shorts
Brand films with social cutdowns
Ad creative made for Meta and Google
Social media management: planning, posting and replies
Single and multi-camera live streaming
Edited files sized for web, social and print

steps.title: Learn
steps.text: We study your best posts, reviews and competitors to see what your audience stops for.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: Shot lists and scripts built around those winners.

steps.title: Shoot & edit
steps.text: One efficient shoot day produces weeks of on-brand content.

steps.title: Post & learn
steps.text: Results shape next month's plan, so every round gets sharper.

faq.q: Where do you shoot?
faq.a: On site at your business across New York City and North Jersey. Travel outside that area is quoted separately.

faq.q: Do I own the photos and videos?
faq.a: Yes. You get full commercial use of everything we deliver for your business.

faq.q: How fast do we get the files?
faq.a: Photos and short videos are usually delivered within 5 to 7 business days. Brand films take longer and are scheduled up front.

faq.q: Can you run our social accounts?
faq.a: Yes. Managed Social covers planning, writing, posting and replying to comments every month.
